data.body:
Implementation SHIPPED and MERGED on main via two Gerrit changes:

* 1599 'Scope no-file-impact drift to the review read-set' (merged as f6308f3d5e)
* 1616 'Keep declared-none tickets exempt from drift' (merged as 69509d47fb)

Both carried LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before submit.

All five acceptance criteria were verified against the final merged tree
(69509d47fb): 27 unit tests in tests/unit/test_plan_review_attest_drift.py
pass, 88 tests in tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_plan_review_gate.py pass,
and ADR 0002 carries the addendum. The AC boxes are ticked.

CLOSE IS BLOCKED ON AN INFRASTRUCTURE FAILURE, NOT ON PLAN CONTENT.
Plan review #8 (against merged HEAD 69509d47fb) returned verdict PASS with
ZERO blocking findings, but minting the attestation failed:

  flock: could not acquire lock after 60s
  (holder: pid=27160 held=66s pid_state=live), retryable: true

That lock was held by a concurrently running sibling agent; pid 27160 has
since exited. Because signing failed, the active attestation is still the
older one (verified_at_sha f7e684c3), which now reads stale-code since the
ticket's 10 declared file_impact paths changed when 1599/1616 landed. The
close gate therefore reports stale-material/stale-code.

Remedy is a single re-run of 'rebar review-plan 81ca-9443-3443-4d27' to mint
the attestation; it is being held pending a coordinator cost decision, since
a ninth full LLM review was explicitly bounded. No code or plan change is
outstanding.
